services.desc: Coho Salmon are present in Puget Sound all 12months of the year. Many leave the sound for the fertile feeding grounds of the pacific and return to the Seattle area starting in mid-August and peak around the second week of September Silver salmon are caught deep into October most years. Resident Coho salmon tend to stay in Puget Sound never reaching the Size of their ocean-going cousins. June, July and August are the main months for resident Silvers. The retention is highly regulated, but with strong returns forecasted the 2026 Season is open June through October.
